verdict.rationale: Bitbucket offers a built-in Jira UI for managing issues inside Bitbucket, and community users praise Bitbucket's own issue management and mention issue comments, so issue tracking exists as a first-party capability. Nothing in the evidence documents labels, assignees, or classifying issues as bugs, features, or requirements, and the community reports are dated. Missing for 10: documented labels, documented assignees, issue types (bug/feature/requirement), in-depth first-party issue-tracker docs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can track bugs, features, and requirements as issues with labels and assignees

citations.quote: Reduce context-switching by managing your Jira issues in Bitbucket with the built-in Jira UI.
I also like Bitbucket's issue management more than GitHub's.
the preview is back in issue comments
